1.consolidated_definition: dep. Porción de una carrera, en la que el tiempo total se mide por acumulación o por promedio y el corredor con menos tiempo es el vencedor. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Luis Benítez y Luis Carmona llegaron 3ro y 4to en un heat que se caracterizó por el alto grado de cansancio de los corredores (Primera Hora, 30-01-04)
1.en_consolidated_definition: A segment of a race, in which the total time is measured by accumulation or average, and the runner with the least time is the winner. Anglicism, often used. Luis Benítez and Luis Carmona came third and fourth in a heat that was characterized by the high degree of fatigue among the runners (First Hour, 30-01-04)
